טבלה: אחריות מקצועית - יועצי השקעות
This table captures risk assessment details for professional liability insurance for investment advisors. It's used to determine policy eligibility and pricing based on the proposer's history and potential liabilities.
ממדים: Risk assessment question regarding the proposer's history and practices, Response (Yes/No) and details if 'Yes'

a) Are there any other facts of which Underwriters should be made aware? Yes / No
Have any present of former partners or directors or employees of the Proposer ever been found guilty of any criminal, dishonest or fraudulent activity and/or investigated by any professional association? If Yes, please give details:
Has the Proposer or any of its directors, officers, partners or employees been subject to, or currently under any regulatory investigation? Yes / No If Yes , please provide full details on a separate sheet.
Did such an investigation result in disciplinary proceeding, admonishments or recommendations? Yes / No
If Yes please provide full details on a separate sheet.
If Yes , were all recommendations implemented? If No , please provide details on a separate sheet.
